message: `every` in `update` starts a new timer every time `update` runs.
notes: `update` runs again and again, and a timer cannot be cancelled: they pile up (the runtime stops starting new ones at 4096 and reports W8205)
help: start the timer once: guard it with a `started` state flag, or start it in an `on` handler
